title: The pinned tensor counit is a morphism of single-functor families
statement: For a morphism g′ of schemes with chosen derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] and additive tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback], give Lg′^* coherent integer shifts compatible with the selected counit of [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition]. Its counit on the degree-n single complex followed by the actual termwise mapped-single comparison defines a morphism of integer SingleFunctors families from the derived single family followed by Lg′^* to tensor pullback followed by the derived single family. Every component equals this explicit composite; no flatness or boundedness is assumed.

source.place: Canonical base-change mate; Tag 0D5S derived pullback composition; Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Shift/SingleFunctors.lean and Mathlib/Algebra/Homology/DerivedCategory/Basic.lean. Shift verification written by N1.

proof.text: Use the termwise mapped-single isomorphism in each degree. Its shift equation is Functor.mapHomologicalComplex_map_singleFunctors_shiftIso_hom_app; cancellation of the shift comparison proves that these isomorphisms form a SingleFunctors isomorphism on cochain complexes.

Pass this family isomorphism through the homotopy quotient using the shift-compatible mapHomotopyCategoryFactors comparison, then through Qh. Whisker the selected counit by the homotopy single family; its assumed CommShift gives a family morphism. Compose these morphisms and the family associators. Their components are the selected counit followed by Qh of the actual termwise mapped-single comparison, by expansion of the quotient factorization. This gives the required family morphism and all its component identities.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_pinned_single_tensor_shifts
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (k : Y ⟶ Z), (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback k).Additive]
    {X X' : Scheme.{u}} (g' : X' ⟶ X) (s : (derivedPullback.{u, w} g').CommShift ℤ)
    (hs : letI := s; NatTrans.CommShift (pinnedPullbackCounit.{u, w} g') ℤ) :
    letI := s
    ∃ τ : (DerivedCategory.singleFunctors
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))).postcomp
          (derivedPullback.{u, w} g') ⟶
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctors
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X'.toRingedSpace))).precomp
          (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g'),
      ∀ n G, (τ.hom n).app G = pinnedSingleTensorCounit.{u, w} g' n G
